work.description: Brief XC approves the Marist Society founded by Claude Colin and allows simple vows and a superior general; LF15605 sup- → LF15617 plici across LXXXIX’s provenance LF15608, own provenance LF15611 and page-107 running title LF15614; LF15678 or- → LF15682 dinationibus across page number LF15681; complete 29 April 1836 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP, XVI. at LF15565–15565; the source closing at LF15685–15688 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima nona aprilis millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, pontificatus No- stri anno sexto.
